desc.en: In the History of Ali bin Anjab, known as Ibne Sayyi, he says: One who recites this supplication, his ways for sustenance would become easy for him…
desc.rurdu: Ali bin Anjab ki taarik mein Ibne Sayyi farmate hai: Jo shakhs is dua ko padhe to usey rizq haasil karne mein aasaani faraaham hogi.

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا سَبَبَ مَنْ لَا سَبَبَ لَهٗ يَا سَبَبَ كُلِّ ذِیْ سَبَبٍ يَا مُسَبِّبُ الْاَسْبَابِ بِغَيْرِ سَبَبٍ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَغْنِنِیْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَبِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَبِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ يَا حَیُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA YAA SABABA MAN LAA SABABA LAHU YAA SABABA KULLE ZEE SABABIN YAA MOSABBE-BUL AS-BAABE BE-GHAIRE SABABIN SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AGHNENEE BE-HALAALE-KA A’N HARAAME-KA WA BE-TAA-A’TEKA A’N MA’SE-YATE-KA WA BE-FAZLE-KA A’MMAN SEWAA-KA YAA HAIYYO YAA QAIYYOOMO.

trans.en: O Allah, O the cause of one for whom there is no cause, O cause of all that have cause. O cause of causes in that where there is no cause. Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad. Make me needless through Your permissible from Your prohibited. And through Your obedience from Your disobedience and by Your Grace from others than You. O the Living, O the Everlasting.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
